ln:4444438361.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: HASE Technology

Job ID: 53421

Principal Responsibilities

  • Manage and drive end-to-end project starting from inception to project closure. Manage delivery proactively, balancing scope, schedule, resourcing, dependencies, communications and budget.
  • Manage the project approach, building stakeholder buy-in around the project plan, commitments and changes.
  • Work closely with the key stakeholders to ensure project progress, risks, financials are managed.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, ensuring timely execution and delivery of milestones & identify and mitigate risks, resolve issues, and ensure project deliverables meet quality standards.
  • Design, develop and implement IT solutions to meet business user requirements.
  • Ensure the tasks delivered meet business requirements and are delivered on time and within budget to an agreed level of quality.
  • Design, develop automated test cases during development process and make sure the test cases are incorporate into the daily build process.
  • Participate in the system integration activities with other teams and make sure the solution complies with group architecture policies and standards.
  • Adopt and provide ongoing improvement on development process and promote usage of right tooling.
  • Work closely with other IT teams on joint development and maintenance systems.
  • Provide support on production case.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Proven track record (5+ years) in development role.
  • Eexperience of delivering high quality and complex system solutions
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills
  • Excellent technical skills in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and Spring Cloud
  • Familiar with Linux and Shell script
  • Knowledge and experience with Distributed systems, Micro-service architecture and APIs
  • Knowledge and experience with relational database
  • Knowledge of DevOps (CI/CD pipelines, test automation and toolings, etc)
  • Able to work in Agile working model
  • Strong passion for technology and engineering
  • Cantonese would be an advantage.
  • Experience in banking systems would be an advantage.
  • Proven experience in AI and python would be an advantage.

/WX/51

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4443819710.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This key position is an exciting opportunity within Markets Production Management. You will be under production support team responsible to provide day to day systems support on a 7* 24 shift schedule, working closely with development teams to understand, review and apply system change to production environment.

  • To provide day to day system support and system monitoring, e.g. ITRS and Control-M, escalate issues with any delays from upstream applications
  • Act as a co-ordination point where there are complex / multiple areas affected by an incident / issue. Track incidents and provide regular updates to users on request status and progress, drive or lead the fast resolution.
  • Acting as the SME of appointed applications. Deep understanding of the application design and able to provide quick fix on any production issue, drive the decrease of production incidents. The target applications could be changed based on the time and business need.
  • Supply agreed metrics, KPI’s and trend reporting. Trend analysis, Incidents resolutions, Root Cause Analysis and Regular Reporting to identify areas for review for improvement.
  • Review production changes and ensure adhere to change control. Partner with different teams to integrate testing results into change acceptance criteria.
  • Working closely with developers, to review and under system package to be rollout in production environment.
  • Drive CIO for bug fix resolution or application enhancements to improve PSS supportability of the platform.
  • Responsible for the review of OLA with upstream and downstream, maintain the support documentation to ensure all areas in scope are current and accurate, ensure all new deployments have supplied correct documentation and training.
  • Ensuring full and timely responses on any PID, CVE/CVM/CCM, Network segregation or other non-listed Security related requests and actions.
  • Able to apply SRE principles in daily jobs and continuously find opportunity to improve system reliability.
  • Contribute to automation on Reboot, Health Check, DR and deployment/Rollback.
  • Able to pick up any ad-hoc task.

Key Responsibilities

Governance

  • The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Dev/QA/Release Management
  • Infrastructure partners
  • Trading, Sales, Quants, Client Services

Skills And Experience

  • Scripting
  • Database (Oracle preferred)
  • UNIX (Scripting experience preferred)
  • Big Data
  • API
  • CI/CD
  • Monitoring

Qualifications

  • Education: University Degree
  • Certifications: ITIL foundation/SRE (preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience supporting financial markets application in an IT department.
  • Ability to own and drive small/ad-hoc project work and deliver to its closure
  • Excellent communication (both written and verbal) and analytical skills
  • Self starter, able to self manage with strong collaboration skills and able to interact effectively with others.
  • Good understanding in infrastructure setup, OS management, capacity review
  • Good understanding in networking concepts and ability to troubleshoot and understand latency issues
  • Ability to work under pressure, multi-task and deliver.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4441269250.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As a Vice President for EPRM team of Large-Cap Segment within Global Corporate Bank, you are responsible for originating, developing and managing relationships with China headquartered companies in the sectors such as energy/renewable, power, metals/mining, EPC, manufactory etc. This division looks to promote corporate banking products and solutions, as well as investment banking products to its clients. You will also work closely with our business partners, including product specialists from Payments & Trade Services, Markets (Commodity, FX, etc.), Debt Capital Markets, Equity Capital Markets & Mergers and Acquisition, etc, to cross-sell customized banking solutions. You are expected have strong motivation and capability of driving new business origination, independent deal executions, and ability to handle senior client relationship (e.g. CFO, Treasurer levels).

Job Responsibilities

  • Identify, originate, pursue, execute business opportunities for a broad range of corporate banking products and services.
  • Manage complex, multi-product client relationships as the primary global client coverage relationship manager.
  • Coordinate the sales and service efforts of multiple internal business partners and stakeholders.
  • Proactively market clients and prospects; represent Corporate Client Banking group in the local corporate banking space and business communities, as well as develop a network of referral sources.
  • Collaborate with the credit risk team on credit risk tasks, structuring, negotiation, and documentation of credit requests.
  • Initiate and maintain strategic dialogue with clients and prospects to generate ongoing corporate banking, financial markets, payment & treasury services, and credit opportunities.
  • Comply with all regulatory and JP Morgan Chase's rules, policies, and procedures.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Minimum Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics or other related disciplines.
  • Minimum of 10 years of prior experiences in client facing roles within Corporate & Commercial Banking, Investment Banking, Financial Markets and/or Payment & Treasury Services.
  • Extensive and strong experience as an outstanding Client Coverage / Relationship Manager marketing and originating corporate banking products and investment banking services.
  • Knowledge of credit, corporate finance, payments & treasury, markets, investment banking, and other corporate banking products.
  • Strong leadership abilities in financial services sales and business development with solid credit, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and self-motivated, dependable team player.
  • Experience and knowledge of sectors such as energy/commodity, power, renewables, EPC would be a plus

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

ln:4471468331.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of International Propositions Manager.

Principal responsibilities

  • Build and maintain performance measurement frameworks for proposition initiatives (funnels, cohorts, conversion, retention, referral, etc.) and ensure consistent cross-market definitions.
  • Develop scalable reporting and dashboards (self-serve where possible) to track KPIs, campaign effectiveness, and customer journeys; automate recurring insight packs.
  • Present insights confidently to senior stakeholders; turn complex analysis into simple narratives, recommendations, and decision-ready materials.
  • Deliver regular market, competitor and customer trend updates (macro/micro, segment behaviours, channel performance) with clear “so what / now what” actions.
  • Provide test-and-learn support: design experiments, evaluate results, quantify incremental impact, and recommend optimisation actions.
  • Partner with data owners and engineering/BI teams to improve data availability, lineage and quality; document assumptions and logic to - prevent inconsistent reporting.
  • Participate in data discovery to determine the most appropriate usage of data to fulfill the requirements
  • End to end project management with cross team (cross location) collaboration
  • Participate in forums, meetings or events to share insights with business stakeholders for campaign evaluations
  • Maintain the highest level of output quality to minimize any occurence of incidents

Requirements

We seek highly motivated specialists who have the following experience and qualifications to join our dynamic organi-zation

  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in one or multiple skills in business analytics or contact and communication design and operation in the financial or digital domains. Or similar experience in analytics consulting or managing digital products.
  • Proven experience in one or more of: customer segmentation, portfolio analytics, pricing analytics, digital mar-keting, data science, use of open-source data in analyses.
  • Familiarity with analytics/visualization tools such as Python, SQL/BigQuery. Tableau/QlikSense/Looker studio, hands-on experience on cloud environments such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus.
  • Ability to communicate with impact, with the capacity to ensure complex information is articulated in a meaningful way to a wide and varied audience.
  • Good problem solving skills, exhibit self-motivated, self-starter behaviors.
  • Great sense of ownership and servicing mind-set to ensure efficient and effective customer service delivery
  • Strong team player; able to work with members of different skills and experiences. Comfortable to operate in a complex matrix structure with multiple stakeholders.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4475419861.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of SR. ASSOCIATE DIRECTOR, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end engineering delivery for lending products/platform capabilities, from discovery through build, release, and production support (APIs, backend services, data, background processing, and operational tooling).
  • Bring a strong business/product mindset: understand customer and business outcomes, challenge requirements constructively, propose product/technical options, and shape solutions that balance value, time-to-market, risk, and cost.
  • Translate business requirements into architecture and technical direction, working closely with Product Owners, BAs, QA, SRE/Operations, and Risk/Compliance partners.
  • Design modern cloud-first architectures (microservices/event-driven where appropriate) with clear trade-offs, focusing on maintainability, security-by-design, and operational simplicity.
  • Own performance engineering: define NFRs, run performance analysis, identify bottlenecks, and drive performance tuning across application, database, messaging, and infrastructure.
  • Build for extreme resilience: design and implement robust patterns such as timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breakers, bulkheads, rate limiting, idempotency, graceful degradation, and strong fallback strategies.
  • Engineer production-ready services with deep observability: structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and SLO-oriented monitoring; ensure self-diagnosis and “self-issue reporting” patterns where feasible.
  • Drive cost-effective delivery: make pragmatic technology choices, optimise cloud and runtime costs, right-size services, reduce waste, and continually improve cost-to-serve (FinOps mindset).
  • Ensure operational excellence end-to-end including: housekeeping (data retention, archiving, cleanup jobs), scaling strategies, capacity planning, DR considerations, and production readiness reviews.
  • Own incident learning loops: lead RCA, implement preventative controls, and reduce repeat incidents through reliability improvements and automation.
  • Lead engineering practices and standards: coding quality, security, architecture guardrails, documentation, and mentoring/coaching across the team.
  • Support modernisation (monolith-to-microservices where justified, platform upgrades, API standardisation, data/event-driven patterns) with measurable outcomes.

Requirements

  • Strong product/engineering leadership: able to influence priorities, propose solution options, and align stakeholders on trade-offs (scope/cost/risk/time).
  • Cost mindset / value engineering: demonstrated ability to deliver outcomes with cost control (cloud cost optimisation, licensing/runtime trade-offs, reducing operational overhead).
  • Modern architecture capability: hands-on experience designing cloud-ready systems with clear NFR ownership (performance, resilience, scalability, security).
  • Strong hands-on Java experience (Java 11+; Java 17 preferred) building enterprise-grade services and APIs.
  • Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC/WebFlux, Spring Security) and API design (REST, OpenAPI/Swagger; versioning/backward compatibility).
  • Microservices and distributed systems patterns: service decomposition, configuration, resiliency patterns, idempotency, consistency models, and safe evolutionary design.
  • Performance engineering experience: profiling, load testing strategy, latency/throughput tuning, JVM tuning basics, database query optimisation, and capacity planning.
  • Database experience: SQL (Oracle/PostgreSQL) and strong understanding of transactions, locking, indexing, and data modelling.
  • Messaging/eventing: Kafka and/or MQ; delivery semantics (at-least-once/exactly-once concepts), ordering, retries, DLQs, and replay strategies.
  • CI/CD and engineering excellence: Git, Maven/Gradle, pipeline automation (Jenkins/GitLab), containerisation (Docker), automated testing (unit/integration/contract).
  • Security-by-design: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, secrets management, OWASP awareness, secure coding and threat-aware design.
  • Banking backend/core banking understanding and ability to work within risk/compliance constraints.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management in global, cross-functional environments; can explain technical decisions in business terms.
  • Delivers production features with strong test coverage and clean, maintainable code.
  • Improves service reliability, resilience, and observability, reducing recurring incidents and MTTR.
  • Improves performance and scalability against agreed NFRs/SLOs.
  • Drives cost-to-serve improvements (reduced cloud spend, reduced operational effort, simpler architectures).
  • Builds trusted relationships with product and operational stakeholders; raises engineering maturity across the team.
  • Accountability: owns outcomes, not just outputs; ensures production readiness and operational stability.
  • Collaboration: works across technology, product, operations, and control functions to deliver shared goals.
  • Inclusion: values different perspectives and builds an inclusive environment.
  • Execution: pragmatic, delivery-focused, balances speed with risk and quality.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

- Build for extreme resilience: design and implement robust patterns such as timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breakers, bulkheads, rate limiting, idempotency, graceful degradation, and strong fallback strategies.
- Engineer production-ready services with deep observability: structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and SLO-oriented monitoring; ensure self-diagnosis and “self-issue reporting” patterns where feasible.
- Drive cost-effective delivery: make pragmatic technology choices, optimise cloud and runtime costs, right-size services, reduce waste, and continually improve cost-to-serve (FinOps mindset).
- Ensure operational excellence end-to-end including: housekeeping (data retention, archiving, cleanup jobs), scaling strategies, capacity planning, DR considerations, and production readiness reviews.
- Own incident learning loops: lead RCA, implement preventative controls, and reduce repeat incidents through reliability improvements and automation.
- Lead engineering practices and standards: coding quality, security, architecture guardrails, documentation, and mentoring/coaching across the team.
- Support modernisation (monolith-to-microservices where justified, platform upgrades, API standardisation, data/event-driven patterns) with measurable outcomes.
Requirements
- Strong product/engineering leadership: able to influence priorities, propose solution options, and align stakeholders on trade-offs (scope/cost/risk/time).
- Cost mindset / value engineering: demonstrated ability to deliver outcomes with cost control (cloud cost optimisation, licensing/runtime trade-offs, reducing operational overhead).
- Modern architecture capability: hands-on experience designing cloud-ready systems with clear NFR ownership (performance, resilience, scalability, security).
- Strong hands-on Java experience (Java 11+; Java 17 preferred) building enterprise-grade services and APIs.
- Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC/WebFlux, Spring Security) and API design (REST, OpenAPI/Swagger; versioning/backward compatibility).
- Microservices and distributed systems patterns: service decomposition, configuration, resiliency patterns, idempotency, consistency models, and safe evolutionary design.
- Performance engineering experience: profiling, load testing strategy, latency/throughput tuning, JVM tuning basics, database query optimisation, and capacity planning.
- Database experience: SQL (Oracle/PostgreSQL) and strong understanding of transactions, locking, indexing, and data modelling.
- Messaging/eventing: Kafka and/or MQ; delivery semantics (at-least-once/exactly-once concepts), ordering, retries, DLQs, and replay strategies.
- CI/CD and engineering excellence: Git, Maven/Gradle, pipeline automation (Jenkins/GitLab), containerisation (Docker), automated testing (unit/integration/contract).
- Security-by-design: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, secrets management, OWASP awareness, secure coding and threat-aware design.
- Banking backend/core banking understanding and ability to work within risk/compliance constraints.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management in global, cross-functional environments; can explain technical decisions in business terms.
- Delivers production features with strong test coverage and clean, maintainable code.
- Improves service reliability, resilience, and observability, reducing recurring incidents and MTTR.
- Improves performance and scalability against agreed NFRs/SLOs.
- Drives cost-to-serve improvements (reduced cloud spend, reduced operational effort, simpler architectures).
- Builds trusted relationships with product and operational stakeholders; raises engineering maturity across the team.
- Accountability: owns outcomes, not just outputs; ensures production readiness and operational stability.
- Collaboration: works across technology, product, operations, and control functions to deliver shared goals.
- Inclusion: values different perspectives and builds an inclusive environment.
- Execution: pragmatic, delivery-focused, balances speed with risk and quality.

ln:4490335399.descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

Details of the Division and Team

Deutsche Bank China, Shanghai Cash Operations mainly focus on payment clearing services to cooperate customers. The products/services commonly provided including Domestic & Cross Border Remittances operation, relevant reporting formalities in accordance with local regulatory requirement and cash product maintenance etc. In addition, Shanghai Cash Operations also provide remittance service to WM/ICM clients.

What We Will Offer You

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

You can expect:

  • Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
  • 15 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
  • A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
  • On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
  • Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members


Your Key Responsibilities

  • Perform daily system operation for RMB X-border payment and Foreign currency payment in line with internal payment processing internal control requirement;
  • Ensure compliance of key processes and procedures with the regulatory environment of cash business in China, such as AML, internal control policy and etc.
  • Support payment message related project & UAT
  • Preparation regulatory reports, like SAFE & PBOC daily transactional reporting and other monthly/quarterly reports
  • Maintain high level of (internal and external) client focus and customer service excellence while clearly following rules/regulations/policies/procedures.
  • Liaise with Sales, Customer service, IB Operations, Loan Operations and DB clients to provide smart solution
  • Closely co-operation and communication with Middle Office and Operations staffs in other branches.
  • Handling and independently resolving local and regional inquiries and related activities


Your Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor degree or above (recognized by the state)
  • Above 5 years relevant experience in a similar field
  • Strong knowledge with SWIFT messaging and xborder RMB payment processing via CIPS
  • Strong team player, ability to engage effectively with the wider Bank team
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Quick learner, self-motivated, independent and be ability to focus and prioritize in high-pressure environment,
  • Attention to details is essential
  • Good general PC skills with exceptional knowledge of Microsoft Excel
  • Fluent written and spoken English and Mandarin
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs


How We’ll Support You

  • Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • Culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
  • Training and development to help you excel in your career


About Us And Our Teams

Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. Click here to see what we do.

Deutsche Bank & Diversity

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist.

Business: CCM and Fin Resource Mgt Tech

Job ID: 66072

Job Board Tags:/WX/51/LP

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead and participate in System Architecture & Design reviews (both High-Level and Low-Level Design), solving complex technical blockers with strong logical thinking.
  • Design, refine, and enforce engineering and SDLC processes to improve team efficiency, code quality, and delivery resilience.
  • Champion the exploration and implementation of AI / GenAI tools and practices into software delivery workflows and business process automation.
  • Lead engineering and delivery teams, providing mentorship, project management oversight, resource planning, and technical direction.
  • Act as the technical/service lead for ITSO duties, overseeing IT Risk Management, regulatory compliance, and driving end-to-end Vulnerability Remediation.
  • Review and govern Incident, Problem, Change, Event, and Capacity management; lead major production incident triage and ensure robust Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to prevent recurrence.
  • Drive Cloud (GCP) and infrastructure review, capacity planning, application optimization, and service resiliency governance.
  • Manage certificate renewal ownership, system health, and technical currency governance.
  • Drive effective stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration across global teams

Requirements

  • Strong Technical Background & System Design: Proven track record in enterprise-grade software development, distributed system design, microservices, and modern architectural patterns.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Exceptional logical thinking and structured problem-solving capabilities in resolving complex engineering and production challenges.
  • SDLC & Process Optimization: Deep expertise across the full Software Development Life Cycle (build, test, deploy, run), with proven experience designing robust delivery processes and testing frameworks.
  • Team Leadership & Project Management: Proven experience in managing, mentoring software engineering teams and delivering multi-stream projects end-to-end.
  • AI Knowledge & Practical Adoption: Strong awareness of modern AI technologies, with the vision and hands-on ability to apply AI into daily team delivery, automation, and business use cases.
  • ITSO, IT Risk & Vulnerability Management: In-depth knowledge of ITSO functions, IT risk control frameworks, security governance, and end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle remediation.
  • Cloud & Modern Tech Stack: Strong hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (especially Google Cloud Platform / GCP), Java API development, microservices, databases, and middleware (MQ, Redis, API Gateway).
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Excellent cross-team collaboration skills and proven track record in managing both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Operational Excellence: Solid experience in Incident, Problem, Change, and Capacity Management within an enterprise DevOps/Agile environment.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Principal Responsibilities

  • Drive the end-to-end product delivery, from requirements and solution design through to development, testing, deployment and production.
  • Dedicate your time to hands-on Java coding, including the design and development of database, Linux, microservices and cloud solutions, in the mean time, should have the knowldege of GCP/AWS cloud engieering.

  • Break programmes into manageable deliveries, remove team impediments and lead retrospectives across teams.

  • Develop team capability by communicating clearly, coaching junior colleagues and supporting their career growth.

  • 10+ years’ experience in Java, Node.js, databases, Linux and open-source frameworks, with strong hands-on Java development experience.
  • Proficiency in Java EE, Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Spring Integration, Spring MVC, Hibernate/JPA and MyBatis.
  • Strong experience in microservices, live-live architecture, Spring Cloud, API gateways, authentication and cloud implementation.
  • Experience with CI/CD and delivery tools, including Jenkins, Maven, Gradle, NPM, Nexus, G3 and Ansible.

  • Experience with object-oriented design, design patterns, Agile methods, scripting and application development across all tiers; willing to learn emerging technologies such as cloud and big data.
  • Strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills; able to work independently, follow HSBC standards, and communicate fluently in English and Chinese.
  • Knowledge or experience in cloud technology adoption such as AWS/Azure /GCP is a plus.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Analyst.

Principal responsibilities

  • The incumbent will be required to work extensively with the analysts and associates in Guangzhou and global investment banking professionals on preparing presentation materials and participating in pitches and deals – this will involve conducting industry and product research; benchmarking, profiling companies, case studies, preparing financing models and valuation analysis (relative and absolute valuation methods, Merger models, etc.)
  • Focus on supporting origination of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) assignments, divestitures, financial restructurings and associated financing solutions
  • Support the team members by performing financial analysis and research as per the requirements
  • Acquire in-depth understanding of client needs and the market, industry and business environment. This understanding enables the firm to design customized solutions for clients - whether it is strategic initiatives like M&A, financing or risk management solutions
  • The incumbent will work on a very wide variety of projects on the above asks with colleagues from across the world
